title: KotlinForForge issue #75: 1.19.2 crashes after installing KFF
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (LGPL-2.1) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by BartholomewIII]
Trying to install cobblemon which requires KFF. Everytime I install any version of KFF the game crashes with exit code 2. It loads just fine without KFF installed but says that I need to install KFF for the cobblemon mod to work.

[comment by thedarkcolour (owner)]
You're missing Architectury API.

[comment by BartholomewIII (none)]
This fixed it thanks.
